definitions.short: Laish , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H3919. Layish II. לַ֫יִשׁ proper name, of a location (on meaning lion , compare RS Semitic i. 156 (om. 2nd ed.) ); — former name of Dan, in extreme north of Canaan, Judg 18:7 , 14 , 27 , 29 (see דָּן b); ᵐ5 Λαισα ; = לֶשֶׁם q. v.; compare Buhl Geogr. § 124 . III. לַ֫יִשׁ proper name, masculine father of Michal's second husband , 1Sam 25:44 + 2Sam 3:15 Qr (Kt לושׁ ), ᵐ5 A Λμεις , Σελλης , ᵐ5 L Ιωας , Σελλειμ . לַ֫יְשָׁה proper name, of a location North of Jerusalem Isa 10:30 (perhaps akin to III. לַיִשׁ , see Di); site unknown; see Kasteren ZPV xiii. 101 conjecture `Isawiye , village two miles northeast from Jerusalem (PEF Map; Mem. iii. 27 Rob BR i. 437 compare Buhl Geogr. 175 ), ᵐ5 ἐν Σα , Λαισα .
